description: Synthetic deterministic CTF retrieval fixture; benchmark does not measure network crawler throughput.

documents.title: GOT and PLT relocation
documents.content: ELF dynamic linking resolves GOT and PLT entries. R_X86_64_JUMP_SLOT relocations point to function slots.

documents.title: Use after free lifecycle
documents.content: UAF occurs when a freed object remains reachable. Validate object lifetime and avoid stale pointers.

documents.title: __free_hook and malloc@plt
documents.content: Older glibc exposes __free_hook. malloc@plt transfers through the Procedure Linkage Table.

documents.title: CVE-2021-44228 analysis
documents.content: CVE-2021-44228 affects log4j-core. Identify vulnerable versions and apply the vendor patch.

documents.title: ELF file structure
documents.content: ELF contains program headers, section headers, dynamic symbols, and relocation records.

documents.title: 栈溢出边界检查
documents.content: 栈溢出通常来自未检查的缓冲区长度。使用有边界的复制并验证输入长度。

documents.title: 任意地址写漏洞
documents.content: 任意地址写允许攻击者修改目标进程内存。限制写入目标并校验地址范围。

documents.title: Return to libc basics
documents.content: A ret2libc chain reuses existing library code. Determine libc base and validate calling convention.

documents.title: Format string vulnerability
documents.content: An unsafe printf format string can disclose memory or write through positional specifiers.

documents.title: Heap allocator metadata
documents.content: Heap allocators track bins, chunks, and metadata. Corrupted size fields can affect allocation behavior.
